title: Concept: Sidekiq web dashboard disclosed
description: Sidekiq job arguments routinely carry user identifiers, email addresses and tokens, and the dashboard renders them for every failed job. The same page also carries the actions that retry or delete those jobs.
applicability: Responses from a Ruby application that mounts Sidekiq::Web without authentication.
risk: The caller reads failed job arguments and can retry or delete jobs, which changes application state from outside the application.
